source: The affordance overlay's token values (plans/research/DESIGN.md §1.5 'aff.' values, R1, R4, R8): raised controls never transparent, control boundaries of at least 3:1, a focus colour of at least 3:1 on every dark surface. Applied over the VS Code base when `Theme::affordances` is on (the default); off gives the exact VS Code colours (VIS1's base). The affordance sheet itself (`@layer sv.affordance`, R1-R18) is DS3's.

notes.button2-hover: Not in DESIGN.md's table: with the raised #313131 rest fill, Dark Modern's #2B2B2B hover would darken. #3B3B3B is VS Code's own derivation of the secondary hover (lighten(button.secondaryBackground, .2)) applied to #313131. VIS1 tunes it.
notes.button2-border: VS Code's secondary button border (button.secondaryBorder, #CCCCCC26 / #3B3B3B26) is below 3:1; the overlay gives it the control boundary (R4).
